payload.text: I'll add a divide helper that safely returns None when the denominator is zero, so callers never see a ZeroDivisionError.

payload.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mathutil.py
@@
+def safe_divide(a, b):
+    # returns None on zero denominator
+    return a / b
